top_signals.title: European Stocks Post Fifth Monthly Gains on Fed Policy Optimism
top_signals.summary: European stocks posted a fifth straight monthly advance, even as Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh vowed to tackle sticky inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Stocks Rise as Warsh’s Pledge Sinks Two-Year Notes: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Wall Street traders sent stocks higher as Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh’s vow to bring inflation under control bolstered market confidence after a recent selloff in longer-dated Treasuries.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: BOE’s Mann on Hawkish Policy, Inflation, Reaction Functions
top_signals.summary: Bank of England Monetary Policy Committee member Catherine Mann discusses central bank reaction functions and managing inflation from supply shocks. She also points to research showing evidence of the immediate effect that central bank decisions can have on economic activity. Mann speaks on the sidelines of the Jackson Hole Economic Policy Symposium. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
